The plate looks like a side plate, about 20 cm across, and it holds roughly 3-4 strips of cooked bacon. Cooked bacon runs about 8 g per strip and about 45 kcal per strip. These strips look long and fairly thick, so I'll assume about 10 g each. That gives about 4 strips × 10 g = 40 g, or roughly 4 × 50 = 200 kcal. The strips are crisp and look like they may be folded or broken into pieces, so I'll settle on about 35 g and 180 kcal.
